title: MIGRO: A Decoupled and Portable Long-Term Memory System for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.15315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models evolve, but the observations, revisions, and context accumulated through user interactions should remain usable. Each new model must be able to retrieve past evidence, track revisions, and add new observations. We present MIGRO, a decoupled long-term memory system that treats experience as a persistent state shared across successive language models.   MIGRO follows a simple principle: preserve historical evidence exactly, organize it approximately, and decide what to retrieve only when the question is known. We call this asymmetric fidelity with deferred selectivity. A shared semantic index supports retrieval, while exact records retain observations and their historical relationships. Because models differ in vocabulary and tokenization, host-specific interfaces convert selected evidence into inputs the receiving model can use. translated_title: MIGRO：一种面向语言模型的解耦式可移植长期记忆系统
translated_abstract: 语言模型会不断演进，但通过用户交互积累的观察记录、修订内容和上下文应当保持可用。每一个新模型都必须能够检索过去的证据、追踪修订并添加新的观察记录。我们提出了MIGRO，一种解耦的长期记忆系统，它将经验视为在相继的语言模型之间共享的持久状态。MIGRO遵循一个简单的原则：精确地保存历史证据，以近似的方式组织它们，并且只在问题已知时才决定检索什么。我们将其称为“非对称保真与延迟选择性”。共享的语义索引支持检索，而精确的记录则保留观察内容及其历史关系。由于不同模型在词汇表和分词方式上存在差异，面向宿主的专用接口会将选定的证据转换为接收模型可用的输入。可逆编码在支持精确恢复的同时减少了归档存储。共享状态……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: MIGRO提出了一种解耦且可移植的长期记忆系统，通过“非对称保真与延迟选择性”原则——精确保存历史证据、近似组织索引、延迟检索决策——将用户交互积累的经验作为持久状态，在相继的语言模型之间共享与复用。
en_tdlr: MIGRO is a decoupled, portable long-term memory system that treats accumulated user-interaction experience as persistent state shared across successive language models, following the principle of asymmetric fidelity with deferred selectivity—preserving exact records while deferring retrieval decisions until the question is known.
